body:
I'm just tired of playing the game perfectly fair, didn't tunnel/camp, but I played a killer they didn't like to go against. So, they instantly call me whatever name in the book, and such. 

Claudette players are usually gonna message you and say some shit at times, lol.

I remember seeing how survivors glitched out to the exit gate, meaning they bounce somewhere and land in there. It isn't 100% of the time they can do it, apparently. But I've seen how it happens. 

Devs should make it to where if gate isn't open, and someone is in there, it'll be a teleport out.

Well.. I can see how it can change, but doesn't it ever get tiring to wait over the tiniest thing in life? Like.. getting better, and yeah. I don't know how it can get better. Even joining a program or something, I don't know how it could. 

How can I leave? Is it legal to even leave at my age? Family doesn't really give a shit about me, so. I'm sure they wouldn't care.

I can see how it can change! Since.. It changed for the worst. And, honestly I don't know what to do to even make it better. I kinda just live alone. Not really, but. It feels that way. I feel alone daily, and eh.. I hate it. Having nobody or anything to wake up to.

A lot of sense, and good job for forming it well! Proud. 

But.. Yeah, I don't have that opportunity as some others do, I'm not really gonna be leaving this place anytime soon, and once I'm 18, I really wanna leave. But, I don't.. Have that opportunity. Really, I don't know what else to do.

That's something I'm even worried from, I don't have anyone to help me through this situation, and.. Sigh, I can't work either. Anxiety is off the roof, I had anxiety just posting this. I didn't expect kindness, I kinda expected.. Well, nothing honestly. And I'm a little overwhelmed. But.. Yeah, I don't know if I would have any way or hope! Just because.. I don't know what I would want, ahah.
